issues.problem: Rule, Q1 and tip said any sub-clause including 'because' clauses forces が; false (から/けど/が clauses take は, and the guide's own example 肉は食べますが、魚は… contradicts it).
issues.action: Restricted the rule to noun-modifying and if/when clauses (たら, ば, と, とき, 前に) and noted that が/けど/から clauses can carry は.

issues.problem: English 'Tanaka came (it was Tanaka who came)' was clumsy and dropped さん.
issues.action: Changed to 'It was Tanaka-san who came.'

issues.problem: Q1 said へ is never possible with 置く and 入れる, and Q2 said へ is rare with 入る/着く; both are false (部屋へ入る, 箱へ入れる are normal). Contrast also listed 'putting' as に-only.
issues.action: Q1 now lists 会う, いる, ある, 住む; Q2 says に is the safe choice and へ also appears with 着く/入る but not with 乗る/座る; contrast says 'meeting, existence, boarding or time'.

issues.problem: Intro and mistake note said 'only へ' can come before の, which contradicts までの in Q3.
issues.action: Reworded to 'へ, not に, can go before の' and 'Before の, use へ'.
